intro: Everything the team must know to build this system — scope, features, data, technical and delivery. The AI drafts what the request and the clarification interview cover; the team fills in the rest. The SRS stays the formal signed document.

hint.background: How the work is done today and what goes wrong
hint.objectives: Measurable where possible — one per line
hint.stakeholders: Requestor, key user (UAT), approver, owner after go-live — one per line
hint.in_scope: Main areas covered — one per line
hint.assumptions: What is taken as true for planning — one per line
hint.constraints: Deadline and why, budget, other systems / projects / vendors, standards — one per line
hint.roles: Role — what it may do, one per line
hint.process: How work flows through the new system (the Design tab can hold the flowchart)
hint.business_rules: Calculations, validations, approval conditions — one per line
hint.notifications: Who is told what, when, how — one per line
hint.entities: Data — key fields, one per line (the Design tab can hold the ER diagram)
hint.migration: Source, volume, who cleans the data
hint.data_volume: Records per day / month, how long to keep
hint.integrations: System — direction, method, frequency, data, one per line
hint.non_functional: Performance, hours / shifts, security, audit log, PDPA, IATF / ISO traceability, backup — one per line
hint.environment: PC, tablet on the shop floor, handheld scanner, network…
hint.tech_approach: Stack, hosting, reuse of existing systems
hint.milestones: Date — milestone / deliverable, one per line
hint.testing: Who tests, test rounds, UAT acceptance
hint.go_live: Go-live plan, training, hypercare, who owns the system afterwards
hint.open_questions: What is still missing or undecided — one per line

emptyPlan: No project definition yet. Let the AI draft what the request covers, then fill in the rest and save.
aiDraft: AI draft — not saved yet. Check every section, fill in what is missing (marked "Team fills in"), then save.
aiUnedited: Drafted by AI and saved without edits — worth a check.
notesPlaceholder: Paste meeting notes, e-mails or decisions made after the request — the AI treats them as newer than the request.
updateHelp: The AI keeps what the team wrote and adds what is new.
generating: The AI is reading the request… this can take a minute or two.
off: AI is not set up on this server.
failed: Could not reach the AI — please try again.

discard.title: Discard the AI draft?
discard.description: The draft has not been saved.

noRequest: Created without a request — paste the requirements in the box above for the AI to work from.
